svg.title: 05b · Security Architecture: Target
svg.desc: Proposed design. FSP traffic passes edge protection and an API gateway enforcing mTLS and OAuth2 bound to FSPIOP-Source, then a service mesh with strict mTLS and default-deny network policies where switch services validate and sign JWS. Data stores use TLS, authentication and encryption at rest. Operators use SSO with MFA through an identity-aware proxy and a permission service. Keys live in an HSM and vault with automated certificates; security events go to a SIEM.
svg.text: A proposed defence-in-depth design: authenticated connections, signed messages, segmented networks, protected data, managed keys and monitored operations
